question: Which of the following organisations conducted the CROPS experiment to study plant growth in space in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** conducted the **CROPS experiment** in **February 2025** to study plant growth in space under microgravity conditions.
 
• The experiment aims to understand how plants behave and adapt in a **space environment** where there is no gravitational pull.
 
• This is part of ISRO's broader efforts to explore the possibilities of supporting human life on long-duration space missions, such as interplanetary exploration.
 
• ISRO's focus on space agriculture highlights its efforts in technological innovation and creating sustainable solutions for space missions.
 
• The CROPS experiment is a significant advancement in the domain of **space farming**, contributing to the understanding of how food production can be managed during extraterrestrial expeditions.
